facts.text: Lingnan House, the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, is listed in the Michelin Guide Guangzhou for 2020 to 2026.
Lingnan House serves dim sum and Cantonese classics.
facts.excerpt: Meticulously crafted dim sum and exquisite Cantonese classics.

facts.text: Too High is a bar offering 107 hand-picked single malts, along with rare rums, smoky mezcal and hard-to-find Cognacs.
facts.excerpt: Explore 107 hand-picked single malts, rare rums, smoky mezcal and hard-to-find Cognacs.

facts.text: Black Iron serves contemporary Japanese cuisine specialising in sukiyaki, sashimi and teppanyaki.
facts.excerpt: contemporary Japanese cuisine specialising in sukiyaki, sashimi and teppanyaki.

facts.text: Brick Lane is an outdoor bar with a modern brewery, a cocktail and wine bar, and live music.
facts.excerpt: Brick Lane is home to a modern brewery, cocktail, and wine bar with sultry live music.

facts.text: Patina European Brasserie & Terrace is a seafood brasserie with a touch of European charm.
facts.excerpt: A delectable seafood brasserie with a touch of European charm, set within the backdrop of unmatched city views.

facts.text: The Butterfly Room is the lobby lounge, serving afternoon tea with sweet and savory bites.
facts.excerpt: For the art of the afternoon tea, explore a selection of refined sweet and savory bites alongside carefully curated tipples.

facts.text: Butterfly Patisserie offers French pastries, chocolates and confections.
facts.excerpt: Savor exquisite French pastries, chocolates, and confections at Butterfly Patisserie

facts.text: Canton Tower View Deluxe Rooms have floor-to-ceiling city views.
facts.excerpt: Canton Tower View Deluxe Room** Luxurious showcase of contemporary elegance with awe-inspiring, floor-to-ceiling city vistas

facts.text: Manor Suites are residential-style suites overlooking the Guangzhou cityscape, with executive lounge access.
facts.excerpt: A residential-style retreat overlooking the glittering Guangzhou cityscape complemented with executive lounge access

facts.text: Xi Guan House is a duplex corner suite with wrap-around views.
facts.excerpt: A duplex unit with wrap-around views, this sophisticated corner suite is a vision of modern luxury

facts.text: Deluxe River Rooms have views of the Pearl River and a king bed.
facts.excerpt: Elegant hotel rooms with sparkling views of the Pearl River, offering a king bed

facts.text: The hotel's design blends modern design with Southern Chinese heritage.
facts.excerpt: Blending modern design with Southern Chinese heritage and unparalleled city views

facts.text: Guests can design their own Bloom Bucket in a flower workshop with the hotel's in-house florist.
facts.excerpt: Design and create your very own Bloom Bucket, together with our in-house florist.

facts.text: The Old to New Cycling Discovery traces the evolution of Guangzhou by bike.
facts.excerpt: Trace the evolution of Guangzhou by bike, through architecture, aromas and the stories of each street.

facts.text: Asaya Active, the hotel's wellness space, offers Augustinus Bader body and facial treatments.
facts.excerpt: Discover restorative Augustinus Bader treatments that blend scientific innovation with deeply nurturing techniques.

facts.text: A Curated Guangzhou Journey takes guests to Guangzhou's cultural landmarks.
facts.excerpt: Discover Guangzhou’s cultural landmarks and ignite your passion to explore and experience the soul of the city.

facts.text: Rosewood Guangzhou was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards 2024.
Black Iron describes its Japanese cuisine as world class.
facts.excerpt: World class contemporary Japanese cuisine specialising in sukiyaki, sashimi and teppanyaki.
